empirical_dispersion.caveat: n=28 (26 for totals). Small sample; directional, not final. Corpus: data/played_games_2026_11_11_12.json + data/played_games_2026_11_13_14.json.

flags.item: Repeated matchups printed by the official schedule: POR@MIN on both 11/16 and 11/17, NYK@TOR on both 11/15 and 11/17 (same venues).
flags.detail: Rows transcribed from the official schedule with distinct game IDs (verified in the per-game link URLs on 2026-11-15); carried as printed and flagged for manual confirmation.

flags.item: No home-court advantage in any line.
flags.detail: HCA could not be sourced from an official NBA page; home moneylines are understated by exactly the real HCA. (Build B's measured home-win-rate 57.6% note remains a published finding, not applied.)

flags.item: Inputs dated, disclosed: ratings re-cut 2026-11-15 (games through 11/14); records post-11/14; injury edition 11/15 06:15 AM ET.
flags.detail: Every pick built on these lines is labelled MODEL OUTPUT — UNVALIDATED and stamped with this as-of date. Records go stale as the 11/15+ games complete (rolling refresh job).

flags.item: No injury report rows cover the 11/16-11/18 games yet.
flags.detail: The official 11/15 06:15 AM ET edition prints NOT YET SUBMITTED for all 11/16 team blocks and no rows for 11/17-11/18. Game-day editions appear 11 a.m.-1 p.m. local per league policy.

flags.item: DAL@BOS (11/15) prints NOT YET SUBMITTED for Dallas; NYK block absent from the edition entirely.
flags.detail: Dallas is on the second game of a back-to-back (league deadline 1 p.m. local game day). The edition prints NOT YET SUBMITTED rows for unsubmitted teams, so New York's absent block most likely means no reportable players - recorded, not inferred (F69).

flags.item: 13 injury rows lost their Team cell to PDF merged cells; team_effective inherits the nearest printed team.
flags.detail: Rows are marked team_inherited in data/official/injury_2026-11-15_0615AM.json and are published with that caveat (F69). No line moves: no absence classifies as NEW_ABSENCE from evidence in this repo (canonical rule, scripts/injury_impact.py) -> adjustment 0.

flags.item: No market prices exist anywhere on this page.
flags.detail: No sportsbook feed is reachable or claimed; every probability is model-internal. Market-comparison gates (G4/G5) stay blocked.

flags.item: No strategy has passed the validation gates (Build A 0/8, Build B 0/10).
flags.detail: Every pick is therefore MODEL OUTPUT — UNVALIDATED, unfunded, and capped at zero stake until a strategy passes the gates. Outcomes: data/derived/strategies.json (Build A), docs/data/leaderboard.json (Build B) — internal artifacts, not official NBA sources.
